files.model.tcl:
# GeoAI isolated axial-column / prescribed-soil-spring verification model
# Units: SI; no gravity, bending, buckling, contact or design checks
# One-dimensional coordinate/DOF represents local vertical z, upward positive.
wipe
model BasicBuilder -ndm 1 -ndf 1
node 1 0
fix 1 0
node 2 0
uniaxialMaterial Elastic 1 200000000000
uniaxialMaterial Elastic 2 100000000
element zeroLength 1 1 2 -mat 2 -dir 1
node 3 3
element truss 2 2 3 0.01 1
timeSeries Linear 1
pattern Plain 1 1 {load 3 -100000}
constraints Plain
numberer Plain
system BandGeneral
test NormUnbalance 1e-8 10 0
algorithm Linear
integrator LoadControl 1.0
analysis Static
set rc [analyze 1]
set f [open summary.tsv w]
puts $f "version	[version]"
puts $f "convergence	$rc"
if {$rc != 0} {close $f; exit 2}
reactions
puts $f "reaction	[format %.17g [nodeReaction 1 1]]"
close $f
set f [open nodes.tsv w]
puts $f "1	[format %.17g [nodeCoord 1 1]]	[format %.17g [nodeDisp 1 1]]"
puts $f "2	[format %.17g [nodeCoord 2 1]]	[format %.17g [nodeDisp 2 1]]"
puts $f "3	[format %.17g [nodeCoord 3 1]]	[format %.17g [nodeDisp 3 1]]"
close $f
set f [open forces.tsv w]
puts $f "2	[format %.17g [lindex [eleResponse 2 axialForce] 0]]"
close $f
wipe
exit 0
